text: dsh-whisper-local 是面向 DSH Web 语音输入的本地语音识别插件，通过注册 host-local speech provider，把录音交给本机 whisper.cpp 和所选 GGML 模型转写。它支持自动语言检测、多语言转写、在插件页面选择识别模型，并通过 whisper_model 工具查询、下载或切换模型。适合希望在 DSH 撰写消息时使用本机语音输入的用户。无需 API key；首次准备时会下载运行时和模型。

dsh-whisper-local adds local Whisper transcription to DSH Web voice input. Its provider runs whisper.cpp with automatic detection and selectable models. The plugin page and whisper_model tool support model status, downloads, and switching. No API key is needed; setup downloads runtime and model.
想用麦克风说话并把内容转成 DSH 输入框里的文字。
让 DSH 的语音输入在本机完成识别。
I want to dictate into DSH and have the recording transcribed locally.
dsh-whisper-local 的功能「本地语音转写」：DSH 语音输入调用 host-local provider，在本机运行 whisper.cpp 将录音转成文字并返回给输入流程；可使用自动检测或指定语言。
dsh-whisper-local 的功能「管理识别模型」：插件设置页可选模型并保存；whisper_model 工具可查看状态、后台下载或切换模型，未准备的模型会启动准备流程。
dsh-whisper-local 使用前须知：首次准备会从 GitHub 下载运行时、从 Hugging Face 下载模型；转写在本机处理。（见 provider.js:434-449、472-490、859-914）

dsh-whisper-local README · Whisper Local for DeepSeek Harness：Local, offline speech recognition for the DeepSeek Harness Web GUI, powered by
[whisper.cpp](https://github.com/ggml-org/whisper.cpp). It plugs into the
Harness voice-input pipeline as a `host-local` speech provider: audio is
recorded by the browser, transcribed on the Host machine, and never sent over
the network.

dsh-whisper-local README · Whisper Local for DeepSeek Harness：- No OpenAI account, no API key.
- 99 Whisper languages plus automatic language detection.
- Model selector built into the Harness UI.
- Managed runtime and model downloads with size + SHA-256 verification.
- Agent tool `whisper_model` so the assistant can inspect and change the model.

> This is a community bundle, not an official DeepSeek plugin.

dsh-whisper-local README · Features：- **Fully local dictation** | `whisper-cli.exe` runs on the CPU; the model and
  audio stay on the machine.
- **Automatic language detection by default** | `language: auto` lets Whisper
  identify each recording's language; any of the 99 Whisper languages can still
  be forced from the voice settings.
- **Model selection in the UI** | pick tiny, base, small, medium or
  large-v3-turbo from the plugin page; the change is persisted and applied
  immediately.
- **Managed setup** | the Windows x64 whisper.cpp runtime and GGML model are
  downloaded on demand, verified (size + SHA-256), cached, and reused offline.
- **No microphone data retention** | each recording is written to a temporary
  WAV, transcribed, then deleted.
- **Agent integration** | the assistant can list models, download one in the
  background, or switch the active model through `whisper_model`.

dsh-whisper-local README · How it works：```
Browser (Harness composer)
  └─ microphone button records 16 kHz mono PCM WAV
       └─ speech Remote sends the recording to the Host
            └─ whisper-local SpeechProvider

The provider registers through `ctx.speechToText.register()` and advertises
itself as `location: 'host-local'`, so the voice UI shows preparation state and
lets the user download the model when needed.

dsh-whisper-local README · Requirements：| Requirement | Details |
|---|---|
| DeepSeek Harness | Desktop/Web build with the experimental **Voice Input** bundle enabled |
| OS | Windows 10/11 x64 (the pinned runtime is a Windows CPU build) |
| Runtime | `tar.exe` (built into Windows 10/11) for extracting the runtime archive |
| Disk | ~90 MB for the extracted runtime + 31–547 MB per model (see table) |
| CPU | Any x64 CPU; more cores and threads improve speed. GPU is not used |
| Microphone | OS + browser microphone permission |
dsh-whisper-local README · Requirements：No Node.js, Python, compiler, or CUDA installation is required at runtime.

dsh-whisper-local README · From GitHub (recommended)：1. Enable the official **Voice Input** bundle: **Plugins → Voice Input**.
2. Open **Plugins → Add plugin → Install a third-party plugin**.
3. Enter the repository Git address:

```text
   git+https://github.com/Linj1k/dsh-whisper-local.git
   ```

dsh-whisper-local README · From GitHub (recommended)：Pin a release for reproducibility with
   `git+https://github.com/Linj1k/dsh-whisper-local.git#v1.3.0`.
4. Confirm the bundle is enabled. Its patch selects `whisper-local` with
   `language: auto` for the voice module and registers the `whisper_model`
   tool.
5. If the Host module was added while Harness is running and the provider does
   not appear, restart Harness once. Browser-only UI changes are hot-reloaded.

dsh-whisper-local README · From a release tarball：Download `dsh-whisper-local-1.3.0.tgz` from the GitHub Releases page and point
**Plugins → Add plugin** at the file.

dsh-whisper-local README · From npm (after publication)：The package name is `dsh-whisper-local`. Once the maintainer has run
`npm publish`, install it by entering the package name (optionally pinned, for
example `dsh-whisper-local@1.3.0`) in **Plugins → Add plugin**.

dsh-whisper-local README · From a local checkout：Install the absolute path of this folder through **Plugins → Add plugin**.
Useful for development.

dsh-whisper-local README · Dictation：1. Click the **microphone** button in the composer, between the model selector
   and **Send**.
2. Allow microphone access the first time.
3. Speak, then press **Stop**.
4. The transcript is inserted into the draft; review and send it normally.

dsh-whisper-local README · Choosing a model：Open **Plugins → Whisper local**. The bundle page offers:

- a model dropdown with sizes and speed/accuracy hints;
- the currently active model;
- a **Save model** button.

The selection is written through the Harness Settings service into the profile
configuration, so it survives restarts. If the chosen model is not downloaded
yet, preparation starts automatically; progress is shown in the **Voice Input**
bundle details (Download and prepare).

dsh-whisper-local README · Language selection：Whisper local advertises 99 languages plus `auto`. Change the language in
**Plugins → Voice Input → bundle details → Language**. The official selector
displays translated labels for `auto`, `en`, `zh`, `ja`, `ko`; other languages
appear as ISO codes such as `fr`, `de`, `es`, `ja`.

dsh-whisper-local README · Language selection：**The default is `auto` (automatic detection), not a fixed language.** French is
not forced: a recording is detected on its own unless a specific language is
selected. Automatic detection is a good default for mixed-language use; forcing
the exact language improves reliability on short or noisy recordings.

dsh-whisper-local README · Models：All models are multilingual Whisper GGML builds, hosted by
[ggerganov/whisper.cpp](https://huggingface.co/ggerganov/whisper.cpp).

dsh-whisper-local README · Models：| Key | File | Size (binary) | Notes |
|---|---|---|---|
| `tiny-q5_1` | `ggml-tiny-q5_1.bin` | ~31 MB | Fastest, lowest accuracy |
| `base-q5_1` | `ggml-base-q5_1.bin` | ~57 MB | Fast, basic accuracy |
| `small-q5_1` | `ggml-small-q5_1.bin` | ~181 MB | Default; good balance |
| `medium-q5_0` | `ggml-medium-q5_0.bin` | ~514 MB | More accurate, slower |
| `large-v3-turbo-q5_0` | `ggml-large-v3-turbo-q5_0.bin` | ~547 MB | Best multilingual accuracy |

dsh-whisper-local README · Models：Measured on an AMD Ryzen 9 9950X3D with 8 threads, for roughly 10 seconds of
speech:

| Model | French | Japanese |
|---|---|---|
| `small-q5_1` | ~1.3 s | ~1.2 s |
| `large-v3-turbo-q5_0` | ~3.3 s | ~4.0 s |

The pinned whisper.cpp runtime is the official nightly
`b5454` Windows x64 OpenBLAS build, verified by its release SHA-256.

dsh-whisper-local README · Configuration：The bundle patch (`cordis.patch.yml`) supplies defaults:

```yaml
- insert:
    - id: whisper-local
      name: 'dsh-whisper-local'
      config:

dsh-whisper-local README · Configuration：| Field | Default | Meaning |
|---|---|---|
| `dataRoot` | `%USERPROFILE%\.dsh\speech-to-text\whisper-local` | Managed location for runtime, models and diagnostics |
| `model` | `small-q5_1` | One of the model keys above; also editable from the UI |
| `threads` | `8` | CPU threads passed to `whisper-cli` |
| `timeoutMs` | `180000` | Per-transcription deadline |
| `modelPath` | unset | Use an existing GGML model file instead of a managed download |
| `whisperCli` | unset | Use an existing `whisper-cli.exe` instead of the managed runtime |

dsh-whisper-local README · Configuration：User overrides are stored in the profile's patch layer and take precedence over
the bundle defaults. The model selected from the UI is written there as well.

dsh-whisper-local README · Agent tool：The bundle registers the `whisper_model` tool:

| Action | Description |
|---|---|
| `list` | Model catalogue, downloaded state, active model, preparation phase, active downloads |
| `download` | Download a model in the background without changing the active model |
| `set` | Select a model and persist it through Settings; downloads it unless `prepare=false` |
| `prepare` | Prepare/download the currently selected model |

Example: switch to the large model after downloading it in the background.

dsh-whisper-local README · Data and privacy：- **No network calls during dictation.** The only network traffic is the
  one-time runtime/model download performed by the explicit preparation step.
- **No API keys.** The plugin never asks for or stores an OpenAI key.
- **Temporary audio.** Each recording becomes a temporary WAV under the OS temp
  directory and is removed in a `finally` block after transcription.
- **Managed data** lives in `dataRoot`:
  - `runtime/` | extracted whisper.cpp build and `runtime.json` marker;
  - `model/` | downloaded GGML models;
  - `cache/` | downloaded runtime archive;
  - `status.json` | diagnostic snapshot (provider, model, languages, selected
    language, readiness). No audio or transcript content is stored there.
- **Settings persistence** uses the profile's `cordis.patch.yml`; the model
  choice contains no sensitive data.

dsh-whisper-local README · Troubleshooting：**The microphone says the provider is not ready.**
Open **Plugins → Voice Input → details** and use **Download and prepare**. The
setup card downloads the runtime and model and shows progress.

**The model selector shows "settings unavailable".**
The Harness Settings service or `configForms` client service is not mounted in
this profile. Use the voice bundle's preparation page or edit `model` in the
profile patch.

dsh-whisper-local README · Troubleshooting：**No audio is recognized.**
Check the OS microphone permission, that a model is prepared, and the selected
language. Try `auto`, or force the spoken language. For quiet/short recordings,
a larger model helps.

**The plugin row is failed after an update.**
The bundled `provider.js` is plain JavaScript and needs no build, but Host
modules are loaded once per process. Toggling the row or restarting Harness
reloads the module. Check the row's diagnostic in **Plugins**.

dsh-whisper-local README · Troubleshooting：**Diagnostics.**
`dataRoot/status.json` reports the active model, advertised language count,
selected provider/language and readiness. The agent can also call
`whisper_model` with `action: "list"`.

dsh-whisper-local README · Development：| File | Role |
|---|---|
| `package.json` | Bundle manifest (`dsh.bundle.patch`, `dsh.client`, exports) |
| `cordis.patch.yml` | Cordis rows: the provider and the voice selection override |
| `index.js` | Cordis entry; loads Schemastery from the dsh installation and declares the volatile `model` Config field |
| `provider.js` | Speech provider: preparation, downloads, verification, `whisper-cli` execution, `whisper_model` tool |
| `client.js` | Browser page: model selector through `ctx.configForms` |
| `locale/*.json` | Plugin-manager display metadata (`en`, `fr`, `zh`) |
| `tests/*.mjs` | Provider and client tests |
| `tests/fixtures/*.wav` | Small multilingual TTS fixtures for the integration tests |

dsh-whisper-local README · Tests：The provider tests run real transcription with the prepared model in the
default `dataRoot`, so prepare the runtime/model first (or point
`WHISPER_LOCAL_DATA_ROOT` at a prepared directory):

```bash
node tests/local-provider.test.mjs
node tests/client.test.mjs
```

dsh-whisper-local README · Tests：The provider suite covers: provider registration and language list,
idempotent preparation, real French transcription, unprepared-state errors,
explicit English/German/Spanish/Japanese transcription, automatic detection,
model listing through the agent tool, persistence through Settings and invalid
model rejection.

dsh-whisper-local README · Limitations：- **Windows x64 only** for the managed runtime. The provider logic is portable,
  but the pinned download is a Windows build; other platforms need a different
  `whisperCli`/runtime and extraction path.
- **CPU inference only** in this configuration; no GPU acceleration.
- **Complete recordings only** | no streaming captions, wake word or automatic
  send; those are capabilities of the voice subsystem, not this provider.
- **Accuracy varies by model and language.** Low-resource languages may need a
  larger model.
- The official Voice Input selector shows ISO codes for languages without a
  translated label.
- `large-v3-turbo` needs roughly 1–2 GB of RAM during inference and is slower
  than `small`; choose based on your hardware.

dsh-whisper-local README · Publishing：```bash
npm login                 # once per machine
npm pack                  # produces dsh-whisper-local-1.3.0.tgz
git tag -a v1.3.0 -m "v1.3.0"
git push origin main --tags

The GitHub release can attach the tarball produced by `npm pack`. The npm name
`dsh-whisper-local` is available and the package no longer sets `private`.
